name: herdr-desktop-pet
description: Native desktop character companion for Herdr

scripts.build:native: set --; if [ -n "${HERDR_PET_CARGO_TARGET:-}" ]; then set -- --target "$HERDR_PET_CARGO_TARGET"; fi; cargo build --release --locked --target-dir native/target "$@" --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --target-dir native/target "$@" --manifest-path native/update-coordinator/Cargo.toml
